summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, announcing a 1-for-8 reverse stock split, a $500,000 share repurchase program, and a letter to shareholders detailing improved fundamentals. The reverse split is a capital structure action to meet Nasdaq listing requirements, while the buyback returns capital to shareholders. The company also reported gross margin expansion from 6.1% to 29.1%, a $54.6M HHS contract, and reduced net debt. No price per share, premium, or advisors were specified. Watch for Nasdaq compliance and execution of buyback.
